recipes.note: Directory is the shared base of Folder and ZipFolder. Obtain one of those instead.

Directory.note: Directory is a real, class-store-resolvable 4D type: tool4d check-syntax accepts `var $x : 4D.Directory` and rejects fabricated names such as `4D.DirectoryX` with "The class ... is unknown", and accepts assigning a Directory subclass instance to it. It was previously recorded as the type name of one of its two concrete subclasses, which was both arbitrary (Folder vs ZipFolder) and false: callers CAN name this type, and it is the correct declaration type for a value that may be either subclass. isAbstract stays true because the docs present it as a base class obtained via its subclasses.

Document.note: Document is a real, class-store-resolvable 4D type: tool4d check-syntax accepts `var $x : 4D.Document` and rejects fabricated names such as `4D.DocumentX` with "The class ... is unknown", and accepts assigning a Document subclass instance to it. It was previously recorded as the type name of one of its two concrete subclasses, which was both arbitrary (File vs ZipFile) and false: callers CAN name this type, and it is the correct declaration type for a value that may be either subclass. isAbstract stays true because the docs present it as a base class obtained via its subclasses.
